mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% in the month prior to the decision is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discount rates eroding expected equity payoffs.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.25% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the identified tightening episode (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 5% for two consecutive months, labor market strength is interpreted as a positive signal for equity valuations, driving a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite sustained unemployment below 5% (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in consumer demand measured by HOUST (units) coinciding with a decline in industrial supply (INDPRO) creates a contrarian opportunity, producing a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by >10% while INDPRO decreases over the prior month
failure_condition: No significant return in 20 days when the pattern recurs but SPX moves opposite to expectation (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for three months indicates weak manufacturing momentum, which predicts a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
regime_hint: Structural supply shock or weak growth
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive despite INDPRO remaining below 100 for the next 3 months (rolling IC > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) below 305 for two consecutive months suggests deflationary pressure, which is associated with a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite CPIAUCSL remaining below 305 for the next 6 months (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in job openings (PAYEMS) above 200,000 in a month when unemployment is steady, signals labor market loosening and supports a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 200,000 while UNRATE is stable
failure_condition: No significant return over 60 days despite the signal (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both retail (HOUST) and industrial demand (RSAFS) above 1200 and 700, respectively, for one month, creates a double-digit positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return via optimism about growth.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 700 in the same month
failure_condition: No significant return when both proxies are strong but SPX moves negatively (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in real activity proxies (GDPC1 < 23000 for 4 months) indicates a structural soft landing is unlikely, predicting a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 5-day forward return is positive despite continued GDPC1 decline (p < 0.05).
